top_signals.title: S&P 500 Trims Drop as Treasury Selloff Eases: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A rout in Treasuries eased after yields hit multi-decade highs, with stocks trimming losses in a session marked by concerns over inflationary pressures stemming from elevated oil prices.

top_signals.title: Gina Rinehart Backed Lynas to Buy Rare Earths Miner Meteoric
top_signals.summary: Australia’s Lynas Rare Earths Ltd. will acquire Meteoric Resources Ltd. in an all-share deal worth about A$968 million ($670 million), giving it access to an emerging supplier of the critical minerals in Brazil.
